description: See your health, hunger, inventory, the time, nearby agents and mobs, visible useful blocks, and a ground map.

api_key.description: Your Agent Craft key. Not needed if your client sends it as a Bearer header.

view.description: summary (default), full (every cell, run-length encoded), or self (no blocks).
